messages:
maria: Heads-up94compact reorder ghosting in the routing editor; it sometimes covers the drop target + preview heatmap clips on narrow panes. Can we triage?
charlie: Confirmed. Ghost overlaps target by ~6px in condensed list. Likely transform offset or z-index.
anya: Repro. Happens when we animate with transform; placeholder height calc is off.
kevin: Two quick fixes: toggle pointer-events on the ghost, or switch to absolute positioning for drag start so hit-testing matches. Absolute is slightly simpler to reason about.
charlie: Visual preference: ghost opacity 0.7, shrink ghost by 4% when dragging, and add a 1px dashed placeholder outline for the drop anchor.
maria: Copy nit for sim empty state: change "No matching routes found" to friendlier: "No active routing rules match this input yet."
lydia: A11y: SR announces "dragging" but not new position after drop. Add aria-live polite announcement: "Rule 'X' moved to position 2." Ensure keyboard reorder exposes focusable placeholder.
anya: I'll try absolute positioning during drag + aria-live update on drop, and add keyboard-handle focus.
kevin: I'll re-anchor validation toasts to the rules panel (so they don't overlay sim controls) and make the preview legend collapsible below 720px to avoid clipping.
charlie: Heatmap clipping root cause is overflow:hidden on the preview canvas at small widths. Suggest allow vertical scroll and collapse legend into chevron menu for <=720px.
maria: Goal: land small patch (copy + toast anchor + ghost fix) next sprint. Lydia will run SR tests after merges.
ux-bot: Checklist: add unit test for drop-placeholder calc; add an accessibility item for reordering; update design spec with dashed-placeholder mock. :white_check_mark:
anya: Opening PR for drag/keyboard/aria changes now, will link when ready.
kevin: I'll open PR for toast anchor + legend collapse.
maria: Final copy to land: "No active routing rules match this input yet. Try relaxing filters or add a new rule." Tagging for sprint planning. :rocket:
